title.zh: 国内首例植入式脑机接口临床转化
title.en: First invasive BCI clinical translation in China

desc.zh: 与浙大二院神经外科合作，高位截瘫志愿者植入电极，用“意念”控制机械手完成握手、喝水等动作。
desc.en: With the Second Affiliated Hospital, a paralyzed volunteer controlled a robotic hand to shake hands and drink via an invasive BCI.

desc.zh: 侵入式脑机接口脑控机械臂书写汉字：100 个常用汉字离线分类正确率 91.3%，志愿者用意念书写“浙江大学脑机接口”。
desc.en: Brain-controlled robotic arm writes Chinese characters: 91.3% offline accuracy on 100 common characters.

title.zh: “脑写汉字”新突破 · 类脑智能大赛一等奖

desc.zh: “脑写汉字”发表于 Advanced Science，1000 常用字库最高识别率 91.1%；获类脑智能（脑机接口）大赛一等奖，侵入式 BCI 工作获国际 BCI Award 提名。
desc.en: Brain-writing published in Advanced Science, up to 91.1% on a 1000-character library; first prize in the Brain-Inspired Intelligence (BCI) Contest and an international BCI Award nomination.

title.zh: Nature Communications：手写运动的多维编码
title.en: Nature Communications: multidimensional coding of handwriting

desc.zh: 首次系统揭示运动皮层对手写运动的多维编码机制，区分笔画与提笔的神经编码，为高性能“意念打字”奠定理论基础（博士生王泽滨为第一作者）。
desc.en: First systematic account of how motor cortex multidimensionally encodes handwriting, distinguishing pen-down and pen-up states (first author: Ph.D. student Zebin Wang).
